main_text.p: cus annunciavit impletas: aut qui cenfent cum res eædem sint, non eas aliis Sacra- mentis annunciari debuisse complet. quàm iis quibus adhuc complendæ prænun- nunciabantur. Si enim soni verborum quibus loquimur, pro tempore con- tantur, eademque res aliter enunciatur & [?]cienda, aliter facta, nec paribus morarum intervallis, nec iisdem vel totidem litter. syllabicis sonuerunt: quid mirum si de mysteriorum signaculis passio & resurrectio Christi futura promissa est, aliis jam tacta enunciatur; quandoquidem ipsa verba futurum & factum, passurus & passus, re- surrecturus & resurrexit nec tenditer, nec similiter sonare potuerunt. Quid enim sunt aliud quæque corporalia Sacra- menta, nisi quædam quasi verba visibilia, sacrosancta quidem, veruntamen mutabi- lia & temporalia.

25 E quibus nos sequentia deducimus: 1. In Sacramentis Veteris & N. Testamenti offerri res easdem, mutatis tantum signis & Sacramentis, h.e. symbolis. 2. Et hæc signa esse temporalia & mutabilia: res vero diversis ritibus pronunciatas & completas easdem. 3. In re significata nonnisi tantum temporis differentiam; quia Sacramenta Vet. Testamenti prænunciabant erant.

page.notes: The right margin is damaged and overlapped by the text; several marginal words are only partly legible and are transcribed as fragments or omitted where unreadable. The reading "[?]cienda" and the marginal fragments are doubtful. The paragraph-opening "25" is a marginal number in the left margin, printed as a note. The right-hand edge shows the facing page, which is not transcribed.
